Committed, tree clean, throwaway vite stopped. Final report follows.

## 1. Changed

- `frontend/src/components/Btn.tsx` — new `disabledReason?: string` prop with JSDoc. While `disabled` and set: `title={reason}`, `aria-describedby` → sibling `<span className="btn-hint" data-testid="btn-hint">` (rendered before the button so it reads "reason · BUTTON" in right-aligned rows). Enabled or no reason: no hint element, `title` / `aria-describedby` pass through unchanged. Explicit props now win over spread rest.
- `frontend/src/theme/app.css` — `.btn-hint` rule: mono 10.5px, `--ink-3` (same weight as `.dim`), right-aligned, `max-width: 44ch`, `margin-inline-end: 12px`.
- `frontend/src/pages/registry/RegisterView.tsx` — split `regValid` into `regNameValid` / `regBodyValid`; reason = name rule → MCP URL → SKILL.md, first unmet wins. `disabled` expression unchanged.
- `frontend/src/pages/registry/EditView.tsx` — extracted `bundleInvalid` (same expression as before); reason = "No changes to save" → "bundle failed validation".
- `frontend/src/pages/knowledge/CreateView.tsx` — reason = name rule → no files (upload mode) / no bucket (S3 mode).
- `frontend/src/pages/CreateAgentStudio.tsx` — toolbar `▲ Publish`: "Add at least one node"; publish dialog's `▲ Publish` (same label, same form) gets the agent-name rule.
- `frontend/src/pages/EvaluationOnline.tsx` — `▸ CREATE`: no agent → no evaluator / no insight (mode-specific).
- `frontend/src/pages/workspaces/DetailView.tsx` — `RUN BOOTSTRAP`: hub workspace / already running / already READY, in `canBootstrap`'s predicate order; `row === null` (still loading) carries no reason.
- `frontend/src/locales/{en,zh-CN}/common.json` — 16 new keys each (`registry.register.disabled*`, `registry.edit.disabled*`, `knowledge.create.disabled*`, `studio.toolbar.publishDisabledNoNodes`, `studio.publish.disabledName`, `evalPage.online.form.disabled*`, `workspacesPage.detail.bootstrapDisabled*`).

## 3. Acceptance checks

- ✅ `Btn` accepts `disabledReason`; disabled+set → `title` = reason and `aria-describedby` = id of a visible hint containing the reason; enabled → no hint element. JSDoc added. Evidence: `hints.txt` shows `hintText === title` and `hintVisible=true` on all six forms; after typing a valid name + URL on Register: `disabled=false title="" describedby=null hints=0`.
- ✅ Playwright check on all six URLs (`record=YACTYAZrHaBi`, `ws=lab-use2`), both locales: every disabled `.btn.primary` has a non-empty `title` and a visible hint. Output at `/home/ubuntu/workspace/agentcore_launchpad/.claude/self-evolution/runs/SE-006/hints.txt`; screenshots `register.png`, `kb_create.png` (plus `register_valid.png` showing the enabled state, and the probe script `probe_hints.mjs` for the host to re-run).
- ✅ All reasons are i18n keys in en + zh-CN; `i18n_check.py` passes; no hardcoded English (`grep -n disabledReason=` shows only `t(...)` / `undefined`).
- ✅ `make verify` passes; only read-only calls to the host backend were made.
- ✅ `make verify` passes in this worktree (tail above).
- ❌ Hermetic test in the gate: the frontend gate has no unit-test runner (`package.json` scripts are lint/build only), and the change is purely frontend, so there is nothing for `backend/tests/` to assert. Coverage comes from `tsc` (prop typing) and the saved Playwright probe, which is not part of `make verify`. I did not add a test runner because the brief says to avoid new dependencies.
- ✅ `docs/architecture.md` updated. No new routes, so `docs/api.md` untouched; `docs/architecture.md` has no `.zh-CN` twin in the repo.

## 4. Not done / deviations

- **Reasons are more specific than the brief's examples where the predicate splits.** KB Create says "Add at least one file to upload" or "Enter the S3 bucket name" by mode instead of one "Pick a source" string. Online Eval says "Choose an agent", then "Pick at least one evaluator" or "Pick at least one insight". The Register and Studio name rules mention the leading-letter requirement, which the regexes enforce.
- **Busy states carry no reason.** `saving` / `busy` / `row === null` disable the button without a hint, since the label or spinner already says what is happening and the brief scopes reasons to missing or invalid input.
- **Studio's publish dialog button** got a reason too. It shares the `▲ Publish` label the brief names and only dimmed on an invalid name. Everything else is the six forms named.
- **Hint sits before the button in DOM order**, not after, so right-aligned rows read naturally. `aria-describedby` does not depend on order.
- **Pre-existing inconsistency left alone:** `knowledge.create.nameInvalid` claims spaces are allowed but `NAME_RE` rejects them. My new reason follows the regex. Out of scope to change the old string.
- No frontend unit test, as noted above.
